newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thakral in Australian property venture.
newsitem.headline: Thakral in Australian property venture.

text.p: Electronic consumer goods distributors Thakral Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it and its unit, Thakral Holdings Ltd, had together acquired a 50 percent stake in two Australian hotel companies.
The hotel companies, HY Hotels Unit Trust and HY Hotels Pty Ltd, owned two hotels in Sydney valued at a total of A$14.6 million, Thakral said in a statement.
"The long-term strategy for HY Trust and HY Hotels is to acquire hotel assets in both Australia and in the region," it said.
It said the entire cost of Thakral's investment would be funded by the US$25 million investment fund of the company's direct investment division.
The investment was not expected to have any effect on Thakral's net tangible results or any significant impact on its earnings per share for the current financial year, it added.
